sloka: अब्रवीन्नास्मि शक्रस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा ।धनदेन न मे सख्यं विष्णुना नास्मि चोदितः ।। ५.५०.१३।।।।
transliteration: abravīnnāsmi śakrasya yamasya varuṇasya vā ।dhanadena na me sakhyaṁ viṣṇunā nāsmi coditaḥ ।। 5.50.13।।।।

translations.english: The foremost of the vanaras spoke to the lord of ogres in response to the equiries made to him: "I have not come from Indra or Yama or Varuna. I have no friendship with Kubera. I have not been sent by Visnu. By birth I am vanara and I have come here.'
